changes.comment: Internal: a mount desc records whether this device has ever held the room's content (`neverHeld`) and, for a dissolved inner mount, which room it folds into (`absorbInto`) — both read by the peer-side adopt/absorb machine and its boot recovery.

Internal: the concurrent-rename dedupe skips keys under a mount boundary (the adopt machine resolves those by guid) and only collapses text entries, so a binary or a folder entry is never hard-deleted by a pass that could not put it back.
